frozen_on: 2026-11-14, before any retrieval or evaluation run
tokenizer: lowercase, regex [a-z0-9]+ (same as starter retrieval.py); no stemming, no stopword removal
active_query_rule: query has >= 3 relevant papers dated >= T (post-cutoff); only active queries enter RQ1

split.unit: source list (all queries from one curated list stay together)

selection_rule: choose h maximising mean R_post@20 on TUNING active queries subject to mean nDCG@20(all relevant) >= BM25 tuning mean - 0.02; ties -> larger h
primary_metric: R_post@20 = fraction of a query's post-cutoff relevant papers retrieved in top 20 (retrieval-stage temporal coverage ratio)
success_threshold: mean paired gain in R_post@20 >= 0.05 absolute on TEST active queries with 95% bootstrap CI excluding 0, AND mean nDCG@20 drop <= 0.02

uncertainty.paired_test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (two-sided), reported as descriptive support only

relevance: binary: paper appears in the curated list/section (exact normalised title match); unlisted papers treated as non-relevant
